duration: Human startup/readiness unknown; never repair during the demo
summary: Phase 5: the human launches prepared samples directly or through approved local Workstation setup, then observes health/contracts. F5 and RunContainer never hide acquisition.
action_notice: Launch/request/image Restore scopes need human approval; only named local Workstation setup may invoke those approved stages with native confirmation. Ordinary agents and HTML never start apps/containers or acquire tools.

purpose.p: Demonstrate a real synthetic request only after a separately approved human launch.
All expected values below are documented examples, not observed laptop output. Source CI/in-process tests are different evidence from a real running service.

starting_state.p: Accepted runtime/profile, already restored/tested project, available intended ports and a human willing to operate the launcher. No competing setup/Restore work. Container mode additionally needs an existing explicitly restored image and approved runtime.

steps.title: Approve prepared local samples and confirm native launch prompts
steps.where: Workstation setup launch approval or manual named local task

body.p: Actual labels are Run EMI API (local), Run IFSC service (local) and Run FX rates (local), using ports 8080/8081/8082. The named local agent invokes only approved samples through visible execution terminals; the human answers native prompts. Keep exact owned terminal IDs and inspect actual startup before requests.

steps.expect: An observed startup or truthful NOT RUN. Stop only the specific owned task with Ctrl+C, not every similarly named process.

steps.title: Use a second terminal for health and synthetic contracts
steps.where: Second VS Code integrated PowerShell terminal

head: Sample task
Synthetic request at its selected port
Documented expected result, not observed
rows: Normalizes ABCD0123456; valid true. Syntax only, no bank/branch/payment proof
HTTP 200 validation result, valid false: fifth character must be zero
"8800.00" and INR ₹8,800.00; fixed synthetic rate, not market data

body.p: Each task's `/health` should return `{"status":"ok"}` at the reported port. Sample READMEs' direct default-port examples use 8080; use the actual task-selected port for IFSC/FX. Python also exposes `/docs` and `/openapi.json`.
EMI INR displays: ₹21,695.58; ₹52,06,939.20; ₹27,06,939.20. Money is fixed two-decimal JSON strings with exact arithmetic and half-up rounding, not binary floating point.

steps.expect: Only actual observed responses establish this live run; absent startup/response stays unavailable.

steps.title: F5 requires existing debugger and project readiness
steps.where: Run and Debug › FastAPI EMI / Spring Boot IFSC / Go FX

ul: FastAPI EMI uses the existing pinned .venv/debugpy and port 8080.
Spring Boot IFSC uses the approved current JDK 25/restored-tested project and port 8081.
Go FX uses existing approved Delve and the pinned Go toolchain, port 8082.

body.p: No F5 helper install, dependency restoration, runtime substitution or Dev Container acquisition. Missing debugger/prerequisite means NOT RUN, not download.

steps.expect: A human-operated debug session using existing prerequisites, or an explicit missing prerequisite.

steps.title: Container acquisition/build belongs only to explicit Restore

body.p: Human chooses the intended sample and approved runtime, reviews network/image build and explicitly confirms RestoreTarget ContainerImages. All means the three modern application images, not PowerShell or legacy.

Auto selects wslc first and considers Docker only if wslc is absent. Explicit runtime probes only that selected approved runtime; no fallback after failure/denial. Docker remains licence-reviewed optional.

steps.expect: An existing approved local image before Run; no build/pull hidden in Run or F5.

steps.title: RunContainer inspects an existing image and never pulls
steps.where: Terminal › Run EMI API (container) / Run IFSC service (container) / Run FX rates (container)

body.p: The actual container tasks prompt the runtime and confirm the launch; IFSC/FX tasks choose ports 8081/8082. RunContainer inspects the existing local image and uses `--pull=never`. Missing images mean NOT RUN, not a build/pull/restoration fallback.
A Dev Container reopen can acquire an image and is not the no-restoration daily route. Do not change a blocked/broken WSL operation into a policy-bypassing Docker fallback.

steps.expect: Actual human-owned startup and synthetic request, or a truthful stop; no surprise acquisition.

expected.p: Real health/functional responses only when actually observed after human launch. No customer identifiers, account details or external bank/rate calls are needed.

success.p: Record the exact source/runtime/date, actual task endpoint, health and synthetic contract response. Keep historical/in-process evidence labelled separately.

failures.symptom: Port occupied or service never reaches health
failures.cause: An unrelated listener or failed/unfinished owned startup
failures.fix: Read the task outcome and preserve unrelated processes. Human may approve a documented distinct port or stop the exact owned task; no agent blindly relaunches.

failures.cause: Explicit earlier image Restore or approved helper prerequisite absent
failures.fix: Report NOT RUN. The human decides the separate approved acquisition stage; no live install/Restore/F5 workaround.

failures.symptom: Installed wslc operation is failing or policy-denied
failures.fix: Stop and show labelled evidence. Do not select Docker after that failure to bypass the boundary.

recovery.p: Stop only the known owned integrated task with Ctrl+C. Preserve shared runtimes/accounts/distros/images and use a separate reviewed prepared checkout or clearly dated fallback evidence.

limitations.p: No live service/container/F5/HTTP request was performed by the companion. Expected examples are not lender advice, market rates or real IFSC existence checks.

say: The operator launches directly or selects the named local agent with separate approval.
Expected monetary strings are exact synthetic contracts, not live observations.
Run and F5 never hide image, package or helper downloads.
evidence_gaps: No live laptop app/container launch, approved debugger, image restoration, health/functional response or runtime-policy acceptance is claimed.
